yamlCheck.dateAnchor: The year and August 29 opening are YAML-derived. The transcript explicitly corrects Arendum arrival to late August 31 and dates entry into the Elderwood to September 4. Subsequent waking puts the last played day on September 5.
yamlCheck.explanation: The approximate overland montage can fit the working August 29–31 calendar, though its intermediate-day wording is loose. Dated travel reaches September 4; one subsequent overnight reaches September 5. No completed September 6 events appear before the recording stops at plans to scout Mezzar’s house. Missing end coverage is not an established contradiction.

boundaryUncertainties.reading: The opening is about 2 a.m. without a spoken civil date. The approximate travel montage and the first-day/next-morning wording do not independently settle how the opening night was dated.

alternatives.reading: Use the YAML opening date as the civil date of the 2 a.m. scene.
If the legacy August 29 label names the preceding evening, the 2 a.m. scene falls on the next civil date.
